fair_streaming: Play full songs at an audible volume - charts and music-show digital scores are built to count real listening.
Mix the title track with the other songs and with other artists; looping one song on mute is the pattern platforms filter out.
Use one account per device and stay logged in; do not buy streams or use bots - it can get plays removed and accounts banned.
On release day, start right at the release time and keep the playlist running through the first 24 hours.
